title: Uber's head of autonomous mobility and delivery, Sarfraz Maredia, is leaving on November 16 after 12+ years at Uber, the latest exit from its autonomous unit (Natalie Lung/Bloomberg)
summary: Natalie Lung / Bloomberg: Uber's head of autonomous mobility and delivery, Sarfraz Maredia, is leaving on November 16 after 12+ years at Uber, the latest exit from its autonomous unit — An Uber Technologies Inc. executive overseeing the company's global autonomous efforts across ride-hailing and delivery will depart next month …
